title.en: Installed milestone candidate and maintainer fine-tuning
title.zh: 里程碑安装候选与维护者微调

purpose.en: Turn one completed milestone into the installed application the maintainer reviews before the next milestone starts.
purpose.zh: 把一个已完成里程碑变成维护者可评审的已安装应用，再进入下一个里程碑。

entry.en: One milestone's implementation, source review, non-live verification and engineering handoff are complete
entry.zh: 单个里程碑的实现、源码审阅、非真实验证与工程交付均已完成

steps.zh: 打包 macOS 发行产物

steps.en: Install the built application into the Applications directory
steps.zh: 把已构建应用安装到 Applications
启动刚刚安装的那一份应用

steps.en: Stop and hand the running build to the maintainer for fine-tuning
steps.zh: 停止并把运行中的应用交给维护者微调

exit.en: The maintainer has the installed build of this milestone and its fine-tuning result.
exit.zh: 维护者拿到该里程碑的已安装构建及其微调结果。

failure.en: A defect found here repairs the current milestone; it never activates the next one.
failure.zh: 此阶段发现的缺陷在当前里程碑内修复，绝不激活下一个里程碑。

boundary.en: Build, install and launch belong to this delivery step. Driving the interface, user-scenario acceptance and Computer Use stay separate and are not implied; signing, notarization and publication keep their own authorization.
boundary.zh: 构建、安装与启动属于本交付步骤；操作界面、用户场景验收与 Computer Use 另属独立范围，不由此隐含；签名、公证与发布保留各自授权。
